model.frame_step: dimensionless indexing convention, NOT physically universal duration
model.limit: For stationary clocks outside nonrotating spherical mass or small near-Earth height differences, respectively

test_hypothesis.hypothesis: Measured clock-rate ratio varies with specified gravitational potential difference, not scale alone
test_hypothesis.null_hypothesis: Using length/scale without mass, field or motion does not predict a unique proper-time ratio
test_hypothesis.test: Compare predicted Δf/f against atomic clock height differences and GPS clocks; report residuals
test_hypothesis.threshold: To be set before data fitting
